Stock market news | Tata Steel approves ₹28,000 crore deal with APL Apollo

Tata Steel has approved selling its tubes business and its 100% stake in Tata Steel Colours to APL Apollo Tubes. The total transaction is valued at up to ₹28,000 crore, subject to regulatory approvals by March 2028.
